sections.advice: Food stop near Mouy → High point near Persan is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

sections.to: Near Épernon, on the way back
sections.advice: Scenic stretch in Élancourt → Near Épernon, on the way back is the reward section in Paris. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
